item.title: Whiskers 0.8.30
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.30

### Screen Awareness (Optional)

  • Renamed Screen Context to Screen Awareness, with clearer explanations in onboarding and settings so you can decide when to enable it.
  • Improved the surrounding permission and settings copy to better set expectations about what’s used to help AI Enhancement.

    • ### Bulk Transcription: SRT Export

  • SRT export is now only available when your transcription includes real timestamped segments, preventing blank or incorrect subtitle files.

    • ### Improvements

  • The Support feedback form no longer asks for your email, and feedback submission has been streamlined for more reliable delivery.
